sourceInformation.audio: Code-written Web Audio disco/lounge music at 10% default, synthesized effects and jingles, formant-filtered gibberish voices; no audio files

sourceInformation.testing: Headless Chromium WebGPU and WebGL2, scripted full cup, input and physics checks, controller and touch emulation, synthesized audio analysis, two-page multiplayer, AI Hub harness; visual screenshots for layout
sourceInformation.research: No source research or internet searches. Native model knowledge; only supplied AI Hub integration code and downloadable dependencies accessed.

testingFeedback: 6 issues found in browser tests, visual checks and integration review: stale mouse prompts, incorrect Hub metadata, audio/input after Hub end, portrait HUD overlap, title-caption contrast, and pause ignored during point celebrations. All fixed.
0 core gameplay failures or startup blockers. The Hub metadata compatibility defect was fixed before conformance testing.

The natural-physics playthrough of all three Cup events, complemented by the official AI Hub harness with 150 ms latency, 50 ms jitter and 5% packet loss. Final aggregate: 73 checks, 0 failures; the three Hub scenarios also passed all 40 internal assertions.
Headless WebGPU screenshots were blank despite valid rendering; backend/frame assertions and WebGL2 screenshots provided useful verification instead.
engineFeedback: Three.js makes procedural geometry and native clip animation straightforward; Rapier supplies stable elastic contacts.
Headless WebGPU screenshots can be blank; visuals are checked with WebGL2 while renderer state verifies WebGPU.
The paddle-sports rules, controller-first interface, cup progression, procedural audio and host-authoritative networking.
Coordinating WebGPU rendering, fixed-step Rapier physics and responsive input in a single portable HTML file.
A built-in deterministic headless image capture path for WebGPU.
promptFeedback: The source, tactile controls and clear delivery requirements encourage a complete original arcade game.
The broad source collection leaves the exact event selection open; three distinct paddle sports were chosen.
Combining single-file delivery, two networking environments and controller/touch support into a coherent finished slice.
Separate required conformance checks from optional platform coverage, and explicitly distinguish integration documentation from source research.

aiHub.name: Paddle Royale
aiHub.tagline: A little court. A lot of glory.
aiHub.description: A warm, ink-outlined paddle-sports club inspired by Video Olympics. Charge power returns, dash for saves, and claim the crown across three courts, solo or with a rival.
aiHub.controls: Move: W/S, arrows, mouse or left stick; aim: A/D or stick; charge: Space, left click or ×/A; dash: Shift, right click or R1/RB; pause: Esc/Options; touch: drag to move, second finger to dash.
